full_judgment:
Mr. Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J: The dispute in this case relates to the land of plot no. 533 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 162 of Mouza Diakhali. On 24 May 1958 the defendant (predecessor of the respondents 1-15) obtained against the plaintiff Nos. 1-3 and 6-8 a decree for Tk. 210/- as price of the barga crops of the said land in a suit being No. 315 of 1957 from the Court of Small Causes. In Civil Revision No. 815 of 1958 the High Court Division upheld the decree but kept the question of title of the suit land open. 

 3. The plaintiffs alleged that one Paizari Mondal was the owner of the disputed land upon an amicable partition with his brothers and that he had since been in possession thereof. The plaintiffs also alleged that Paizari Mondal had died leaving two sons namely. Nazir Mondal and Sabu Mondal who had since been in exclusive possession of the said land. The plaintiffs alleged further that the names of Nazir and Sabu had been duly recorded in the C.S. Khatian and that they had become the owners thereof by way of inheritance.
